label: mac-loaded-agent
note: M4 MacBook Pro, macOS, native. agent loop replaying a fixture, real local file search and JSON work. loaded: 4 steady + 1 bursty (20-60 s on/off) spinning python processes at nice 0 on 10 cores
warmup: one pair (pair -1, warmup=true), excluded from stats

fields.wall_s: perf_counter around spawn..wait4, includes the /usr/bin/time wrapper where used (same in both arms)
fields.user_s_sys_s: wait4 rusage of the child (and its children)
fields.instructions_cycles: /usr/bin/time -l; includes the wrapper's own startup, a constant in both arms
fields.load1: os.getloadavg()[0] at the start of the pair
fields.cpu_speed_limit: pmset -g therm CPU_Speed_Limit after the pair; 100 when no limit is recorded
fields.linux_perf: perf stat -e instructions:u,cycles:u,cpu-migrations wraps the command (constant in both arms); instructions and cycles are user-space only
fields.cpu_sampled_at_100ms: field 39 of /proc/<child>/stat read once 100 ms after spawn; one sample, not the whole run
fields.steal_ticks: /proc/stat steal, all vCPUs, USER_HZ ticks elapsed across the execution; all_cpu_ticks likewise
fields.per_run_state: with --per-run-state, cpu_speed_limit and power_source are sampled after each run, not each pair
fields.loadavg_start_end: Linux: /proc/loadavg 1-minute value at the start and end of each run
fields.metrics: the full PERFPROOF JSON the command printed, when it has more than one key
